note: Three scenarios now EXECUTE against the real worldmodel path (T-027-10, 2026-08-07); the remaining seven are still pending — specified and designed, not yet implemented (INV-22). The three are grounded in a live adopt performed through the console API on dc1tg01 (governance_ledger seq 9761), so the ordering and rationale properties they assert were observed in production before being pinned here.

scenarios.name: Discovery drafts entries with source provenance and table confidence
scenarios.test: modules/discovery/systemd/systemd_test.go::TestDiscoveryDraftsEntriesWithSourceProvenanceAndTableConfidence + modules/discovery/docker/docker_test.go::TestContainersAreDiscoveredWithProvenanceAndFixedConfidence + core/db/world_discovery_e2e_test.go::TestWorldDiscoveryDraftsThroughTheRealStoreAndIsReadableBack (the draft rows through the REAL store)

scenarios.name: An unknown entity type from a corrupted source is loud-rejected
Adopting an entry appends the ledger row before the row update
scenarios.test: spec/027-world-model-discovery/acceptance/steps_test.go::ledgerPrecedesRow (godog, drives worldmodel.Transition; RED control: write the row before the ledger)

scenarios.name: Reject without a rationale is refused
scenarios.test: spec/027-world-model-discovery/acceptance/steps_test.go::refusedAndUnchanged (godog, drives worldmodel.Transition; RED control: delete the ErrRationaleRequired branch)

scenarios.name: The manifest view renders diffs and honors server-computed caller permissions
scenarios.test: deploy/console/v2/e2e/manifest-review.mjs (Playwright, against the SERVED console): the granted->proposed diff panel must render (assertion: /granted\s*→\s*proposed/i), and with the server answering caller_can_act=false EVERY [data-act] control must be .disabled — disabled rather than hidden, since hiding leaves a read-only operator wondering where the queue went. Also pins the two failure modes either half could hide: a 503 renders an honest unavailable state, and no fabricated row may appear (a fake row on this surface is a fake ACTUATION TARGET one adopt click from being granted). NOTE ON EXECUTION: the console-e2e CI job is changes-gated on deploy/console/v2/**, so this runs on console-touching pipelines, not on every backend change.

scenarios.name: A non-adopted unit is refused at the leaf and the same effect passes after adopt
scenarios.test: spec/027-world-model-discovery/acceptance/steps_test.go::leafRefusesThenPasses (godog, drives worldmodel.NewAllowlistProvider on ONE instance across the adopt; RED control: replace env instead of union)

scenarios.name: Drift marks disappeared entries stale and drafts new entries without auto-retiring
scenarios.test: core/worldmodel/manifest_test.go::TestDriftCanNeverRetireAnApprovedEntry (approved->stale, the withheld manifest:drift ledger decision, and no path draft->retired) + core/db/world_discovery_e2e_test.go::TestWorldDiscoveryDraftsThroughTheRealStoreAndIsReadableBack (re-discovery lands NEW entries as drafts through the real store, and a draft is absent from ApprovedEntries)

scenarios.name: A failing source contributes nothing and is reported loudly
Adoption never lowers confidence and learned contributions stay capped
scenarios.test: core/worldmodel/manifest_test.go::TestAdoptionNeverLowersConfidence (the MAX ratchet AND the learned cap below the 0.80 cutoff)
